def symmetric_kl(logits, other_logits):
    # Both passes use identical candidates and accidental-target exclusions.
    # Keep both probability branches attached to the shared network.
    log_p = nn.functional.log_softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)
    log_q = nn.functional.log_softmax(other_logits.float(), dim=-1)
    return 0.5 * (
        (log_p.exp() * (log_p - log_q)).sum(dim=-1)
        + (log_q.exp() * (log_q - log_p)).sum(dim=-1)
    ).mean()
